summary.headline: Make the project easy to resume.
summary.description: A compact dashboard renderer for project state, evidence, risks, workflow health, skill outputs, and the next action.
summary.checkpointText: Project: Project Workflow. Phase: Verify. Status: the 18-skill plugin, standalone skills, and dashboard are implemented and validated locally. Evidence: PROJECT.md and validation/. Next action: review and commit the v0.2.0 diff, sync with origin/main, then reinstall and verify in a fresh task.
summary.footerNext: Review and commit v0.2.0, sync with origin/main, then reinstall and verify the plugin in a fresh Codex task.

context.Identity: Project Workflow; private repository workspace for focused skills and a reusable status dashboard.
context.Purpose: Reduce repeated context, clarify prompts, preserve project state, and make the next action obvious.
context.Status: The v0.2.0 implementation and packages are complete locally; commit, remote sync, and installation verification remain.
context.Goals: Publish the validated plugin, verify the fresh local installation, and refresh external snapshots.
context.Scope: Eighteen focused pw-* skills, shared Project Context, and the reusable PW dashboard renderer.
context.Constraints: Local-first evidence, compact checkpoints, no hardcoded model catalog, no dashboard-as-source-of-truth.
context.Checkpoint: v0.2.0 implementation branch with final PW inventory and dashboard action cards.

definitionOfDone.text: Dashboard renders compact Project Context without duplicating the whole blueprint.
Missing optional fields hide their cards rather than showing empty filler.
Residual risks and pending external coverage remain explicit.
A future continuation can start from the dashboard and checkpoint without rereading long history.

sequence.purpose: Verify the current project phase, completed work, and open risks.
Choose surface, model, reasoning, tools, plugins, and skills from available capabilities.
Estimate qualitative usage intensity and identify one safe saving move.
Commit, save, or hand off only after validation evidence is recorded.

moduleActions.title: Checkpoint is fresh
moduleActions.state: Updated for the current Verify phase.
moduleActions.detail: Next action: review and commit the validated v0.2.0 implementation.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-project-checkpoint to update the compact continuation state, working set, blockers, and next action.

moduleActions.title: No blocking product decision
moduleActions.state: Clarification is available if a new ambiguity changes implementation.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-grill-me to resolve the most consequential open decision without revisiting settled choices.

moduleActions.title: One terminology conflict
moduleActions.state: Old docs still call the cleaned-prompt behavior Prompt Cleanup.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-grill-with-docs to resolve the Prompt Cleanup versus pw-messy-material terminology and update only the canonical docs.

moduleActions.title: Ready to update the spec
moduleActions.state: The final skill inventory and ownership boundaries are settled.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-to-spec to produce a concise implementation-ready spec from the settled Project Workflow decisions.

moduleActions.title: Destination: fresh Codex task
moduleActions.state: Reference the latest checkpoint and this branch rather than duplicating project history.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-handoff to preview a task-specific transfer to a fresh Codex task, referencing the latest checkpoint.

moduleActions.title: Latest improvement
moduleActions.state: Avoid rereading full histories after a current checkpoint exists.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-retro to review this completed phase for repeated reads, validation loops, routing mistakes, and missing automation.

moduleActions.title: Ready
moduleActions.state: Acceptance criteria: valid inventory, routing, dashboard interactions, package build, and attribution.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-implement to execute the approved Project Workflow specification with only targeted checks.

moduleActions.title: No active prototype
moduleActions.state: Create one only if an unresolved interaction question needs a cheap experiment.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-prototype to test one unresolved dashboard interaction hypothesis and mark the artifact as a prototype.

moduleActions.title: Explain this
moduleActions.state: Re-pitch only the confusing part in current Project Workflow vocabulary.
moduleActions.prompt: Use $pw-wait-what to explain the confusing part of the current Project Workflow state.

prompts.title: Validate current dashboard binding
prompts.label: best
prompts.text: Review the Project Workflow dashboard with the included Project Context fixture. Verify minimal and populated rendering, missing-card behavior, tabs, copy controls, and mobile layout.

prompts.title: Update project checkpoint
prompts.label: scope lock
prompts.text: Using the current project evidence, update PROJECT.md with purpose, confirmed decisions, current state, completion criteria, sources, and next action. Keep it compact.

prompts.title: Prepare plugin handoff
prompts.label: handoff
prompts.text: Create a concise handoff note for this project with objective, completed work, constraints, files changed, validation run, and exact next task.
